# TrustyButton

`Actions` · composition depth: `base`

The button. Variants cover fill style and colour role, and it carries at most one icon (leading wins over trailing). Omit the label for an icon-only button and pair it with an aria-label.

**Use it when**
- the user clicks to make something happen: submitting, opening, triggering.

**Don't use it for**
- a control that stays pressed to represent on/off state: use TrustyToggle

```ts
import { TrustyButton } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "outline" \| "ghost" \| "danger"` | `"primary"` | Fill style / colour role. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` |  |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | `"button"` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `block` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `label` | `string` | — | The button text. Omit for an icon-only button (pair with `aria-label`). |
| `icon` | ``${string}:${string}`` | — | Leading icon (shorthand for `leadingIcon`). Any Iconify `collection:icon` name. |
| `leadingIcon` | ``${string}:${string}`` | — | Icon BEFORE the label. Takes precedence over `trailingIcon` (one icon only). |
| `trailingIcon` | ``${string}:${string}`` | — | Icon AFTER the label. Ignored if a leading icon is also set. |

## Examples in Storybook

- Primary — Default: the primary (solid) variant.
- Secondary — Secondary solid fill.
- Outline — Bordered, transparent fill.
- Ghost — Text-only, no fill or border at rest.
- Danger — Destructive actions (red solid fill) — e.g. the AlertDialog's Delete CTA.
- Small — Three sizes.
- Large
- LeadingIcon — A button carries one icon — the leading one.
- TrailingIcon — A trailing icon (only shown when there is no leading icon).
- IconifyIcon — An Iconify icon (collection:name) resolves through the same prop.
- IconOnly — No label → icon-only, squared off automatically.
- Loading — Busy state: the spinner always sits on the left.
